analysis_scope: Offline existing data only; no new robot/simulator/DDS/inference/GPU operations

phase_definition.INIT_WAIT: Sparse snapshots; no continuous q/dq/torque or decoder/residual observations
phase_definition.CONTROL_PREPLAY: Continuous control before first play=true row; startup/warmup included
phase_definition.PLAY: motion_playing=true, including the last nominal frame despite CONTROL_HOLD writer label
phase_definition.FINAL_HOLD: After a verified complete single reference; not evidence of release or unforced hold
phase_definition.FINAL_NONPLAY_UNVERIFIED: Nonplay after last play row without complete single-reference proof; terminal nominal frame unverified
phase_definition.BETWEEN_PLAY_UNKNOWN: Nonplay between play intervals, if any; no invented pause semantics

alignment_method: raw CSV row i+1 -> producer control row i; hardware map+scale+default float32; verify against sent0 candidates. Held command is latest logged sent1 at or before state logger timestamp, rounding-ambiguous rows excluded from joint summaries.
